title: Al-Layl 92:8-14 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 11 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Layl 92:8-14 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 11. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ (٨) وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ (٩) فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ (١٠) وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ (١١) إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ (١٢) وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ (١٣) فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ (١٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
We will ease him toward difficulty.
And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Ikhfa: ت, and a heavy ظ
Light hum, then full mouth on ظ
Hum two counts on the shaddah noon

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Layl 92:8-14 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 92:8-14 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 92:8-14 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write the opposites: list what the giver does (92:5 to 6) and what the stingy one does (92:8 to 9).
questions.a: Giver: gives, fears Allah, believes in the best. Stingy: withholds, thinks he needs no one, denies the best.

questions.q: Recite 92:1 to 14 to a partner and mark where you paused.
questions.a: Recited in order; pauses only at ayah ends.

options: is stingy and thinks he needs no one
questions.a: A) is stingy and thinks he needs no one. 92:8: 'But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need'. The giver was in 92:5.

questions.q: Al-Layl 92:12: «إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Someone has plenty but will not share. Does his money help him in the end?
questions.a: No: 'His wealth will not avail him when he falls' (92:11). Allah guides and warns (92:12 to 14).
